short: Shared library, cut by the runes seam
is: The shared library, cut by the seam: `api`/`types`/`components`/`testing` are Effect-free and browser-safe; `server/` is the Effect half.
conventions: `$lib/api/*` is the vocabulary that crosses the seam — plain interfaces + `as const` maps.
A rule stated once lives in the shared module both sides import (`handle-format.ts` backs both the Schema field and the brand validator).
Components name a token, never a raw colour or a palette custom property; core components use the design language's names exactly (`ui/`), and the frame's compositions live in `explorer/`.
Icons are inline SVG path data copied from Lucide (ISC) into `components/ui/icons.ts`, always `aria-hidden` beside words.

A `DenHref` is minted only by the Den path builder (`server/den/den-path.ts`) and the bare-root fallback (`components/explorer/den-root.ts`) — eslint enforces it for every spelling of the brand module (any relative path, any extension, and dynamic `import()`); components render Den links, never build them.

fs.name: api/
fs.role: component-facing plain-data contracts: Problem (COMMISSION_NOT_FOUND_PROBLEM among the backend's own, field for field; with its field errors: errors, FieldError, and invalidFieldsProblem mirroring the backend's refused-fields 422), Session, Account, Trail (the path bar's steps: a Den link or a fixed section page, a named step with its name's number), the Den view (den.ts: DenPageData — entries, crumbs and the opened node carry a bare name and its own ordinal, never a composed "name (n)" —, its full shape check isDenPageData, DenOutcome, DenEntry…, DenThing — the commission an open page stands for, by its id, cardTypeWord — a card's type as a word for exactly account/character/commission, none otherwise) and its root route (den-route.ts, pinned to an app with no base path), the sign-out notice (signout.ts: the unconfirmed-sign-out address and its words), HttpStatus, API_PREFIX, FetchFunction

fs.name: components/
fs.role: ProblemNote (the one way a problem renders) + SessionHeader (public pages); `ui/` = the design language's core components by their names (Button, IconButton, Icon, PathBar, Avatar, Dialog, EmptyState, TreeItem, Toggle, Badge, VisibilityMarker, Skeleton — each placeholder row as tall as --row-height — and ShownName, a Den name in its <bdi> with " (n)" outside it, whose text twin for the live region, tooltips and aria labels is shown-name.ts's shownNameText, the name in U+2068…U+2069 with " (n)" outside); `explorer/` = the signed-in frame's own compositions (AppShell, TopBar, Sidebar, Tree + TreeBranch, ViewOptions, NodeHeader, EntryList, DenPane, NewCommission (the create dialog, shown only on the viewer's own commissions folder), RenameCommission (the rename dialog, shown only on an open node standing for a commission: Title starts from the node's bare name, never the shown "name (n)", a hidden field carries the thing's id), ErrorView with its fixed copy in error-copy.ts) and the tree's memory, model and loader

fs.name: navigation.ts
fs.role: loadFullPage — leave for an http(s) location by a full page load, never the client router; any other address is refused (a seam specs mock; navigation.spec.ts)

fs.name: server/
fs.role: the Effect half — runtime, API port, programs, form schemas

fs.name: styles/
fs.role: tokens.css + base.css (imported once by the root layout) and the contrast gate: declared dark-theme colour pairs checked at WCAG 2.2 AA

fs.name: testing/
fs.role: spec-only harnesses: fetch stub, hanging fetch (a backend that never answers until the signal aborts), kit-fetch (SvelteKit's real server event.fetch, through its internals), problem-body builder, redirect assert, superform prop stub

fs.name: types/
fs.role: branded primitives (brand.ts — the one blessed `as` site: ids, handles, PathSegment, the opaque CommissionId, DenHref/DenName/DenType, NameOrdinal via the validated nameOrdinal (a whole number of 2 or more), PageToken, FieldPointer via the validated fieldPointer) + Effect-free rules shared by both sides (handle-format.ts, segment-format.ts)
